definitions.short: a word , answer , letter or decree
definitions.full: H6600. pithgam מִּתְגָם noun masculine Ezra 6:11 command, word, affair (Persian: see Biblical Hebrew); — absolute ׳פ Dan 3:16 ; emphatic מָא - Ezra 4:17 +; — command 6:11 , word , by missive 5:7 , from king 4:17 (both with שְׁלַת ), in answer 5:11 (with התיב ); weakened, thing, affair Dan 3:16 ; 4:14 .
